title: Uniform circuit language is in P
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. Suppose $C$ is polynomial-time-uniform and every circuit in the family is well formed with at most two inputs to each gate. Then the language of strings accepted by $C$ belongs to $\mathrm{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: For every $n$, each gate of $C_n$ has at most two inputs
